I wanted to share my experience to express my gratitude to Dr. Rivière for his professionalism, compassion, gentleness with my pet, invaluable advice, follow-up care, and more. Since February, Dr. Rivière has been treating my 16-year-old cat, who, given his condition upon arrival, was facing a certain and rapid end. After a thorough and accurate diagnosis, my cat was hospitalized twice and given IV fluids, in addition to injections administered at the doctor's office. Over time, we've been able to give him the injections at home thanks to the doctor's guidance. My daughter seems more adept at it than I am. We've maintained all of this daily care, along with the diet recommended by the doctor. After weighing him at the office this past Friday, my cat has gained 400 grams, his eyes are brighter, and we were fortunate enough to take him on vacation with us. We're still keeping a close eye on things, of course, but 7 months have passed and my cat is continuing his quiet life as an old cat, surrounded by his family who love him more than anything and his favorite vet 🤗
